description: Pushes an interval/cardio guide (warmup, timed or distance work intervals, recoveries, repeats; segments auto-advance, optional target HR range) to the user's Suunto account via the SuuntoPlus Guide Cloud API. Needs SUUNTO_APP_NAME to exactly match the app name registered on apizone.suunto.com. No live push: it appears after the phone's next Suunto app sync. Returns Suunto's response (guide id) plus check { verified, note? }: verified:false means the guide was not found in the guide list after the push; say so instead of reporting success. Queued one at a time. Write operation.

blocks.description: Ordered blocks. times>1 repeats the block's segments as a unit; warmup and cooldown go in their own times=1 blocks.

distanceM.description: Auto-advance after this many meters. Exactly one of distanceM or durationSec.

durationSec.description: Auto-advance after this many seconds. Exactly one of durationSec or distanceM.

label.description: Segment name, shown as the step title (truncated to 13 characters).

notifyText.description: Optional vibrate + popup text at segment start.

targetHrMin.description: Lower target HR (bpm). Give with targetHrMax or omit both.

guideId.description: Updates this existing guide instead of creating a new one.

title.description: Session name shown in the Suunto app.

name: push_interval_guide
title: Push interval guide to watch
